# SBC 127.5 fixed biomass coefficients

Nelson, C. J., Reed, D. C., Harrer, S., and Miller, R. J. (2026). SBC LTER: Reef: Coefficients for estimating biomass from body size or percent cover for kelp forest species. Version 5. Environmental Data Initiative. https://doi.org/10.6073/pasta/3a6272c195d7de89eb412cf1f0c4d63e

`Macrocystis_Biomass_Relationships_20261016.csv` is the provider table; the pipeline selects the twelve monthly model-1 zero-intercept dry-foliar relationships. MD5: `8ddaf77458d21adfb6d0398cc1c51fda`. The EML and verification manifest accompany it. Provider licensing and attribution remain those in the EML; these files are not relicensed as project code.

See `docs/KELP_FIXED_COEFFICIENT_REFIT_2026-10-29.md` for the promotion, refit and selection-sensitivity audit.
